title: EY
description:
Hello! Welcome to today's episode of the Healthcare Security Brief podcast, where we explore the current state and future of cybersecurity and partnerships that make a real difference for healthcare organizations. Today, we are excited to have David Cooper, the Microsoft Security Leader for Americas for EY cybersecurity for healthcare.

title: Series Introduction
description:
We're excited to introduce a new podcast series called the Microsoft Healthcare Security Brief. The objective of this new podcast series is to bring together some of our strategic partners in the healthcare security space for a personal discussion on topics we feel can help healthcare organizations be more resilient and proactive across the evolving threat landscape, and hear firsthand some of the experiences and recommendations our partners can share.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
